column1: # Provisional game profile (written on Windows from dm/games/profile_guess.py, not checked by hand)
# iPhone layout of Octopath Traveler 0 (0010...): 3.75 GB guest block, alias = node area + engine region + 256 MB.
# profile_guess guessed the Mac bring-up layout (62 GB reserve / 64 GB alias): the rewriter gives the engine region
# what the alias region has room for (dm/tools/ue_region.py), so the iPhone takes a smaller guest block.
# the NPDM declares 20 MB of system resource
# the decoded shader code archives: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders
